scope: Isolated offline development candidate-discovery pilot, 11 public document fixtures / 7 previously declared queries; not holdout or frozen evaluation
queries_origin: Fixed public fixture.json; seven predeclared queries and target labels retained from the 2026-10-13 pilot

algorithm.prefix: Exact current prepareEmbeddingInput: (path + two newline characters + body).slice(0,8000), JavaScript UTF16 units
algorithm.full: Same path + two newlines + body, no clipping
algorithm.chunks: Same full sequence, fixed nonoverlap <=8000 UTF16 units, boundary moved back one unit when it bisects a surrogate pair; path only in first chunk, no overlap/no repeated title
algorithm.segmentation: Byte-exact pinned source-src-segment.ts, imported using Node TypeScript stripping; escapeFtsQuery extracted from pinned source with TypeScript annotations removed
algorithm.tokenizer: porter unicode61 remove_diacritics 2, external-content single natural FTS5 column; no code rows
algorithm.rank: Strict AND tier0 before relaxed OR tier1, bm25 ascending; exhaust branches, dedup document entity using best row, top3 scoring; deterministic rowid tie break
algorithm.label_use: Target paths used only after ranking; retrieval uses query text and optional exact repository filter
algorithm.timing: One warm query then31 repeated local queries; median includes snippet/highlight window extraction, sorting and dedup; DB build includes insertion/commit but excludes integrity check; preparation separate
algorithm.negative: Only literal absence from this fixture, never production unanswerability

variations_from_production: Local SQLite/Python and Node ICU are not Cloudflare D1/workerd parity proof
Exhaustive branch collection instead of production per-branch topK/outer cap to prevent chunk rows consuming entity slots; prefix/full cap-equivalence audit separately
Added rowid tie break; production equal-score ordering unspecified
No dense, graph, RRF, crossencoder, abstention or end-to-end packet assessment
unknowns: Phrase/token split at chunk boundaries, no overlap
Full sparse source vs embedding prefix vs rerank evidence slice/API fetch-source semantics
D1 size/statement/CPU constraints and runtime segmentation compatibility
Chunk source offsets, stable IDs/entity dedup and rerank/return window provenance
